newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - NEW YORK TIMES FRONT PAGE - AUG 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - NEW YORK TIMES FRONT PAGE - AUG 7.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
* Microsoft to make $150 million investment in Apple Computer .
* President Clinton said the Federal deficit is expected to drop to $37 billion this year.
* The Clinton Administration, in a shift of its Middle East strategy, will press Israel and the Palestinians to negotiate more quickly toward a final peace settlement.
* Grieving families went to Guam to claim the remains of their relatives killed in Wednesday's Korean Air crash.
* Columbia/HCA plans to drastically alter or abandon many of the business practices that helped give it a dominance in the healthcare industry.
* New York judge rejects death penalty plea bargain deal.
* Teamsters leader Carey troubled by UPS' growing use of part-timers since 1968.
